summary: The literacy revolution that I envision may demand of us everything. In return, though, we may have everything to gain in taking important steps toward remaking the world in a way that is more livable, more just, and more human. #quote -Ernest Morrell
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
The literacy revolution that I envision may demand of us everything. In return, though, we may have everything to gain in taking important steps toward remaking the world in a way that is more livable, more just, and more human.
#quote
-Ernest Morrell
